title: Stack
summary: Last in, first out, like a pile of plates.

viz.hello: This stack has room for {n} values and top = {top}. Try push, pop or peek.
viz.pushed: push({value}): top moved up to {index}, and {value} went into that box.
viz.popped: pop(): took {value} from box {index}. top moved down to {top}.
viz.peeked: peek(): the top value is {value}. Nothing moved.
viz.overflow: push({value}): the stack is full, there is no box above {index}. This is overflow.
viz.underflow: The stack is empty (top = -1), so there is nothing to take. This is underflow.
viz.ghost: Faded numbers are old values. They stay in their box until a push writes over them.
viz.resetDone: Started again with an empty stack.
